N.description: A warm, calm woman storyteller in her thirties, clear and gentle voice, reading a story to children
N.sample: Once upon a time, in a quiet little town, there lived two very good friends.

A.description: A nine-year-old girl, bright, curious and confident child voice
A.sample: Come on, I know a shortcut! It will be fun, I promise!

B.description: A nine-year-old boy, gentle, a little shy, soft child voice
B.sample: Um, are you sure about this? Okay, I am right behind you.
